core_claims.disposition: Original cue #1131 00:36:44.480 '아무리 안 좋다고 해도 0이 되진 않아요' contradicted: individual stocks may become zero even without investor margin borrowing. Credit loan debt and market principal loss are distinct.
core_claims.correction: Original video cues #1130-1133 say even poor (unlevered) investments do not drop to 0 except borrowing. This is wrong: an unlevered common stock or equity ETF may become worthless, and a leveraged ETF may lose all initial principal; the correct distinction is that without separate debt/credit, no additional personal loan principal owed solely by holding ordinary cash-purchased shares. Leverage via loans or margin can leave debt.
